title: Little progress reverse-engineering recovered craft: caveman with a USB drive

tellings.quote: I don't think we've done much with what we've recovered. I think it's like uh you know, um caveman with a USB drive.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, gives his own view on the idea that the United States has recovered crafts not made by humans, starting around 1947. He says he doesn't think much has been done with what was recovered, and compares it to a caveman holding a USB drive: owning the thing without any idea how to use it. If true, it would mean the technology is beyond what our scientists can understand.
